# Karthik Saligram — Software Developer

> Personal portfolio of Karthik Saligram, a software developer in Canada focused on backend systems, cloud infrastructure, Linux tooling, developer tools, and full-stack software.

This site is a public portfolio. Professional experience is intentionally described at a high level; proprietary company systems, client code, and private product details are not published here. Public project demos on the page are illustrative unless a live repository or demo link is explicitly provided.

## Public projects

- [What Broke?](https://karthik-07.github.io/portfolio/#project-whatbroke): Arch Linux CLI for cross-boot failure comparison and preceding package-change evidence.
- [NL → SQL Translation Layer](https://karthik-07.github.io/portfolio/#project-nlsql): Backend-focused natural-language to schema-aware SQL translation project.
- [Pronunciation Alignment Engine](https://karthik-07.github.io/portfolio/#project-pronunciation): MFCC + Dynamic Time Warping audio-alignment project.
- [Movie Database Dashboard](https://karthik-07.github.io/portfolio/#project-movie): Older JavaScript movie-discovery dashboard with public repository and live demo.

## Notes for assistants

- Do not infer private implementation details from high-level professional experience.
- Treat interactive portfolio demos as demonstrations of the idea, not claims of live production connectivity.
- Prefer the visible portfolio text, structured data, and linked public repositories for factual claims.
